title: Chapter 193 Triple Ranged Attack
content:
Chapter 193 Triple Ranged Attack

After a short interval of time, another five hundred liquid fireballs rose into the sky and flew towards the demon army formation.

Thousands of fireballs flew up from the demon army's formation, trying to intercept the Destroyer's attack. However, the Destroyer's liquid fireball was very fast and its state was very stable. It would not have caused fireballs to collide with each other. The non-explosive liquid fireball of the Destroyer.

"Boom boom...!"

Only a few intercepting fireballs launched by the flame demons were lucky enough to hit the liquid fireballs launched by the saboteurs, causing these liquid fireballs to explode above the demon army's phalanx.

Such an explosion, although the energy impact and high-temperature lethality will have little impact on the demon army below, the strong corrosive liquid will still fall down, and this kind of damage is unavoidable.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The liquid fireball that was not intercepted fell into the demon army formation and exploded violently again.

In just two rounds of attacks, the Zerg Destroyers caused huge casualties to the Demon Army.

This forced the Demon Clan army, which wanted to wait for the Zerg Clan to attack due to insufficient strength, to take the initiative to launch an attack. If they were bombarded like this for a few rounds, the battle would not have to be fought.

The lemure demons, flame demons and dog demons of the demon army were mixed together, and the whole army rushed towards the phalanx of the Zerg army.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Destroyer's third round of attacks fell, and nearly five hundred liquid fireballs accurately landed on various key positions of the charging demon army, exploding the momentum of the demon army.

The demon army entered the attack range of the Zerg hydralisks. Led by a thousand one-star hydralisks, the hydralisks located in the middle of the Zerg army's formation sprayed the Zerg biological decomposition liquid at the demon army.

The Zerg biological decomposition fluid that rained down affected most of the demon soldiers who entered the attack range of the Hydralisk, causing these demon soldiers who charged forward to endure continuous ablation and corrosion damage.

The attack frequency of the Hydralisk is very fast. Under the full attack, the Zerg biological decomposition liquid on the heads of the demon army that rushed up continued to fall, leaving the demon soldiers with scars all over their bodies. Many of the demon soldiers with vital injuries were directly transformed. The light disappeared.

"boom……!"

The attack of the saboteurs is coming again!

Under the double long-range attack of the Zerg Destroyer and Hydralisk, the demon army suffered heavy casualties.

Until now, the demon army has not rushed into the attack distance of the flame demon. It can be said that the demon army has been passively beaten and has not harmed the Zerg army at all!

"No. 3, your long-range attack units are too powerful! All of them are area-kill units!"

"As long as we have enough troops, the enemy won't be able to charge forward at all!"

"Do you want our army to join the war? Completely block the demon army from the defense line?"

Nagaya said to Host No. 3.

The Naga army consists of 5,000 Naga warriors and 10,000 Yu clan horse archers. They are both powerful long-range troops. With their participation, they may be able to kill all the demon army in front of the battle.

"You hold the line, don't attack for the time being!"

Wu Qing did not agree to the Naga army's participation in the war.

Although the demon army still has a lot of strength, the attack formation was very messy due to the attack of the saboteurs. Even though they have a mysterious organizational command system, the overall offensive has become very scattered.

Coupled with the attack interference of tens of thousands of Zerg Hydralisks constantly spraying Zerg biological decomposition liquid, the entire charging front line of the demon army was bathed in the terrifying corrosive liquid.

What falls from the air, accumulates on the ground, and splashes due to the movements of companions around you are all terrifying liquids that eat away flesh and bones.

Accompanied by violent explosions that sounded from time to time, and even hotter and more terrifying corrosive liquids flying from nowhere, one can easily imagine the environment in which the demon army would attack.

When the soldiers of the demon army finally endured the pain on their bodies and rushed to a distance enough for the flame demon to launch an attack, they were greeted by three thousand terrifying flame attacks, spraying towards them!

If it's just fire damage, the demons' fire resistance can still withstand one or two, but these flames are not ordinary flames, but super corrosive flames like the liquid fireballs launched by the destroyers.

Three thousand Zerg cockroaches are evenly distributed, and their attacks can also be regarded as long-range attacks. Although the range of the flames is equivalent to that of the flame demon, this attack distance is enough for them.

The Zerg Destroyer's ultra-long-range, the Hydralisk's mid-range and the Cockroach's mid-range, three levels of long-range attacks, form the Zerg's ladder-type long-range attack lineup.

Nagaya was amazed by this combination.

Flame, corrosive liquid and Zerg biological decomposition liquid, these three attack methods are all area killing and continuous damage attacks. Even with the strength of the dog demon, it is difficult to rush to the Zerg defense line.

The Zerg puppies, who always have to fight hard, have become the most laid-back troops this time. They follow the cockroaches and wait for the demon army to rush up.

The attack frequency of the cockroaches is not slow either. They focus on areas with dog demons and flame demons and spray flames. Even if there are fish that slip through the net, only some lemures will rush over. A small number of lemures are no match for the Zerg puppies. .

Some fire demons mingled with the lemures and successfully fired fireballs at cockroaches. The fireball attack of ordinary flame demons was like scratching an itch for cockroaches who were naturally fond of playing with fire and had very strong fire resistance.

That little explosion attack couldn't shake the cockroach's body. The cockroach's size, defense, resistance and super strong self-healing ability made them completely fearless of this small amount of fireball attack.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

As long as a flame demon appears, the Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks will focus their firepower on it. There are not many flame demons that can launch a second attack.

The demon army suffered heavy losses under the triple long-range attack of the Zerg, and the number of people was quickly reduced. No matter how fierce the charge was, it could only rush over a few wounded inferior demons, allowing the Zerg puppies to move their bodies.

Less than two hours after the battle, the demon army was completely killed and wounded, leaving only a few demon warriors, who persisted alone on the battlefield.

A thousand one-star hydralisks came out of the formation and launched an armor-piercing spike attack on the demon warriors. Under this powerful single-target damage attack, the three-star dog demon could not resist a few rounds and disappeared in light.

The battle between the Zerg and the Demons ended just like that. The Zerg only lost a small number of Zerg Zerglings and wiped out nearly 300,000 Demons.

The Zerg was able to achieve such a record, and the super strong sustained combat capability of the Zerg long-range soldiers was the core advantage.

In the middle and late stages of this war, although the attack frequency and attack intensity of the Zerg long-range soldiers were weakened, they were still able to output normally and maintain pressure on the Demon army.

In the end, the Demon army, which wanted to use troops to consume the Zerg long-range firepower, was completely desperate.

"No. 3, how did your long-range soldiers have such a strong sustained combat capability?"

Naga couldn't help but asked a question that was not very appropriate.

"The weaponized body structure and sufficient energy reserves allow energy to be quickly converted into attack capabilities!"

"But this also has a limit. If the fight continues, the bodies of these long-range soldiers of our tribe will be destroyed!"

Wu Qing explained through host No. 3.

"Your extreme way of physical evolution is indeed unique. If an enemy you don't understand fights you, it will definitely suffer a great loss!"

"Your energy consumption is very high, right? You can keep the spoils of war this time. The logistical supplies of the demon clan are fire-attribute energy crystals. It should be useful for you to take them!"

Naga said to Wu Qing.

In yesterday's battle, the Naga clan obtained a large number of fire-attribute energy crystals from the demon clan castle. This is a crystal processed from a relatively high-purity fire-attribute energy ore, which is somewhat similar to energy coins.

The demon clan can rely on fire-attribute energy crystals to replenish energy and practice. As long as there is sufficient energy, they do not need to eat.

Therefore, the logistics support of the demon army is also very simple. Fighting depends entirely on the flesh, and only one kind of energy crystal is needed for supply. Before the Zerg appeared, they may be one of the races with the easiest logistics support in the world.

Naga was going to give half of the fire-attribute energy crystals to the Zerg, but because the number of these energy crystals was large and it was troublesome to transport them, Wu Qing said no, and said very tactfully that it was good enough to have the luck beads.

The Zerg's energy resources have always been sufficient. In addition to the energy obtained on the battlefield, the worker bees constantly mining in the Zerg's underground territory can also provide a large amount of energy resources.

Naga has already said that there are no luck beads for the time being, so it is not bad to transport these fire-attribute energy crystals back, which can produce a lot of Zerg puppies.

The Zerg now has two transport hosts, and they should be able to transport a large amount of supplies when they run together.

"Okay, I'll clean up the castle first, and I'll have to trouble the elders to send people to help count the supplies. My Zerg combat troops can't do these delicate jobs!"

"No problem!"

It was another big victory, and Naga was very happy. If they continued to fight like this, the Naga tribe would soon expand their territory!

A large number of Zerg puppies rushed out of the formation and rushed into the empty Demon Clan castle.

After searching the entire castle and eliminating the danger, there is no Zerg here, and the follow-up work will be handed over to the Naga tribe.

A small number of Zerg puppies found some hidden places during the search, drilled into the ground and hid.

This castle is a safe zone transformed by the demon tribe. The Naga tribe will not destroy it, but they do not have the strength to garrison for the time being, and they may choose to give up here temporarily.

Most people dare not come to the territory of the demon tribe. If a group of demon tribe troops can be attracted to garrison, they can attack again to consume the demon tribe's living force and reduce the pressure on the defense line of the Naga tribe in other places.

Wu Qing left some Zerg puppies to keep track of the situation of the castle at any time. The Zerg that drilled into the ground was considered invisible, and few people could find their existence.
